user.title: Menstrual cycle
user.description: Predictions are estimates based on the logged cycles. They are not medical advice and must not be used as contraception.

data.name: Name
data.last_period_start: First day of the last period

data_description.last_period_start: Optional. You can log more periods later from the calendar or with the services.
data_description.cycle_length: Used until at least two periods are logged.
data_description.period_length: Used until at least one period has an end date.
data_description.luteal_phase: Days between ovulation and the next period, usually 14.
data_description.history_size: How many recent cycles are averaged to predict the next one.
data_description.forecast_cycles: How many future cycles are shown in the calendar.

error.luteal_too_long: The luteal phase must be shorter than the cycle.

log_period_start.name: Log period start
log_period_start.description: Logs the first day of a period.

config_entry.name: Cycle
config_entry.description: Needed only if more than one cycle is configured.

log_period_end.name: Log period end
log_period_end.description: Logs the last day of the most recent period.

add_period.name: Add period
add_period.description: Logs a whole period, for example a past one.

end.name: Last day
end.description: Last day of the period, if known.

date.name: First day
date.description: First day of the period to delete.

period_overlaps.message: This overlaps the period starting on {date}.

no_period_to_end.message: No period starts on or before this date.

period_too_long.message: The period starting on {date} would last {max} days or more. Log a new period instead.

invalid_period.message: The last day must be on or after the first day and the period must last less than {max} days.

cannot_delete_prediction.message: Predictions can't be deleted, only logged periods.

entry_not_found.message: No menstrual cycle is set up.

entry_required.message: More than one cycle is set up: choose which one.
